class Box<T> {
  value!: T;
  method(item: T): T { return item; }
  self(): this { return this; }
}
const n: number = Box.prototype.value;
const converted: Box<string> = Box.prototype;
const valueFromSelf: Box<string> = Box.prototype.self();
const methodOutput: number = Box.prototype.method('text');
console.log(n, typeof converted, valueFromSelf === Box.prototype, methodOutput);
function outer<T>(value: T) {
  class Nested<U extends string = 'default'> {
    outer!: T;
    inner!: U;
    fromOuter(): T { return value; }
  }
  const out: T = Nested.prototype.outer;
  const erasedOuter: number = Nested.prototype.outer;
  const own: boolean = Nested.prototype.inner;
  const erasedResult: number = Nested.prototype.fromOuter();
  console.log(typeof out, typeof own, erasedOuter, erasedResult);
}
function nonGenericOuter<T>(value: T) {
  class Local {
    outer!: T;
    fromOuter(): T { return value; }
  }
  const erasedOuter: number = Local.prototype.outer;
  const erasedResult: number = Local.prototype.fromOuter();
  console.log(erasedOuter, erasedResult);
}
class Derived<T extends string> extends Box<T> {}
const inherited: boolean = Derived.prototype.method(42);
const ClassExpression = class<U> { read(value: U): U { return value; } };
const expressionResult: number = ClassExpression.prototype.read('expression');
console.log(inherited, expressionResult);
